detail.longDescription: I'm building omegon cloud, a small container hosting platform that's Swedish-owned and hosted in Sweden 🇸🇪 Deploy a container, point your own domain at it, and it's live. Managed databases and storage are planned. It's early and not ready for production yet, so I'm looking for a few developers with side projects to try it and give feedback. Free, invite-only early access. Curious? Request an invite at https:// omegon.cloud # BuildInPublic # Docker # Hosting # EuropeanTech # IndieDev
